shortDescription: Module for setup of SSLProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: accepted_ciphers
options.description: Ciphers suites represented as defined by U(http://www.openssl.org/docs/apps/ciphers.html). Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as AES:3DES:RC4.

options.name: accepted_versions
options.description: Set of versions accepted by the server.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: cipher_enums
options.description: Enum options - tls_ecdhe_ecdsa_with_aes_128_gcm_sha256, tls_ecdhe_ecdsa_with_aes_256_gcm_sha384, tls_ecdhe_rsa_with_aes_128_gcm_sha256, tls_ecdhe_rsa_with_aes_256_gcm_sha384, tls_ecdhe_ecdsa_with_aes_128_cbc_sha256, tls_ecdhe_ecdsa_with_aes_256_cbc_sha384, tls_ecdhe_rsa_with_aes_128_cbc_sha256, tls_ecdhe_rsa_with_aes_256_cbc_sha384, tls_rsa_with_aes_128_gcm_sha256, tls_rsa_with_aes_256_gcm_sha384, tls_rsa_with_aes_128_cbc_sha256, tls_rsa_with_aes_256_cbc_sha256, tls_ecdhe_ecdsa_with_aes_128_cbc_

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: dhparam
options.description: Dh parameters used in ssl. At this time, it is not configurable and is set to 2048 bits.

options.name: enable_ssl_session_reuse
options.description: Enable ssl session re-use. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: prefer_client_cipher_ordering
options.description: Prefer the ssl cipher ordering presented by the client during the ssl handshake over the one specified in the ssl profile. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: send_close_notify
options.description: Send 'close notify' alert message for a clean shutdown of the ssl connection. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: ssl_rating
options.description: Sslrating settings for sslprofile.

options.name: ssl_session_timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds before an ssl session expires. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 86400.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tag.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Ssl profile type. Enum options - SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_APPLICATION, SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_SYSTEM. Field introduced in 17.2.8. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_PROFILE_TYPE_APPLICATION.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.
